Now comes Distant Memoraĵo—two new chapters in the tale of Rin and Ruka.

Not all endings are happily ever after, and language isn't the only barrier to understanding. After choosing to remain in Ruka's world, Rin begins to doubt her decision, haunted by memories of her best friend Yuuzu and others she's left behind. Ruka, too, is troubled by Kanako, a classmate who seems to have it out for her. Unspoken thoughts, assumed feelings, and misunderstandings threaten to pry them apart as they face the challenges of communication involved in becoming more than just friends.

In the second chapter, we learn the tale of a distant past. Of a child and a young adult paired together by strange circumstances. This story of Rei and Ruka's past will explore how the two met, why Rei took on the mantle of guardianship, and their attempts to understand one another across an age gap.

notes.title: The Expression Amrilato is Now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1044490/The_Expression_Amrilato/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017084/cd54444bc44dea31f4bacdc05dedc90580e1e2e6.jpg[/img][/url]

From the masters of localization at MangaGamer comes a stunning linguistic achievement - a yuri visual novel that will teach readers Esperanto - The Expression: Amrilato!

At first glance, The Expression: Amrilato is an all-ages yuri tale of a girl named Rin who's suddenly whisked away to another world, a rather common tale in anime, manga, and games. Yet what truly makes The Expression: Amrilato so unique and wonderful is the language barrier Rin faces. Though the girl who takes Rin in, Ruka, speaks a small spattering of Rin's language, the language of this other world is entirely foreign and unknown to Rin. Lost in a world where she's unable to communicate with others, Rin and the reader both must struggle together to learn the language of the world she finds herself in, which is represented with the actual language, Esperanto.

Players will be thrust head first into Rin's predicament, surrounded by a world that communicates only in Esperanto, with her savior Ruka struggling to teach her their language. As the story unfolds, The Expression: Amrilato introduces language lessons that teach Rin and the player how to understand Esperanto, with the text in-game constantly evolving to show Rin's incomplete knowledge of the language, whether it's none at all, solely pronunciation of words, or whole words and phrases. As the language barrier falls, so too do the barriers keeping Rin and Ruka apart.

The game even features an extensive quiz-style study mode for those who are dedicated to learning Esperanto! Those looking to use The Expression: Amrilato as a legitimate tool for learning Esperanto will not be disappointed either. All the Esperanto text in game was officially supervised and approved by the National Esperanto Association in Japan, and English experts on Esperanto have further reviewed the localizations for accuracy as well. 

This heart-warming tale and amazing educational tool is now available on Steam, so order your copy today and get 20% off!

notes.title: Version 2.0 - Japanese and Chinese language options, new features
notes.content:
Version 2.0 is a significant update, introducing new features, the original Japanese script, and new translations in Simplified and Traditional Chinese.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10023194/f0cbbdff6f0db94ebeec0e23e5983402d0af1b26.png[/img]

When you start this new version for the first time, you will be asked to select a language. This will affect all in-game text, including menus. It can be changed at any time from the System menu, the fourth option on the title screen and the last option on the left side of the in-game text box.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10023194/8ed004ce882be155d917afb9a961ccc0933da623.png[/img]

Several features first introduced in [i]A Kiss For The Petals - The New Generation![/i] have been added to this version:
[list]
[*]The ability to adjust the opacity of the text box freely.
[*]The option to render text with a shadow or outline, which can be changed independently of the text box opacity setting.
[*]An option to pause the text when a full-screen CG is shown. By default, it will pause until the user clicks.
[/list]
These options are available in the second page of the System menu.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10023194/7126d6af3892c9b66cd3eb1cc7c2f4f07dcd3179.png[/img]

Version 2.0 is built in Ren'Py 6.99.12.4, which features optimizations with the Steam overlay.

When you start this new version for the first time, you will be asked to select a language. This will affect all in-game text, including menus. It can be changed at any time from the System menu, the fourth option on the title screen and the last option on the left side of the in-game text box.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10023194/8ed004ce882be155d917afb9a961ccc0933da623.png[/img]

Several features first introduced in [i]A Kiss For The Petals - The New Generation![/i] have been added to this version:
[list]
[*]The ability to adjust the opacity of the text box freely.
[*]The option to render text with a shadow or outline, which can be changed independently of the text box opacity setting.
[*]An option to pause the text when a full-screen CG is shown. By default, it will pause until the user clicks.
[/list]
These options are available in the second page of the System menu.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10023194/7126d6af3892c9b66cd3eb1cc7c2f4f07dcd3179.png[/img]

Version 2.0 is built in Ren'Py 6.99.12.4, which features optimizations with the Steam overlay.

WebP is a highly efficient format developed by Google that boasts significantly smaller file sizes than PNG. As a result, the total size for the images in Remembering How We Met has been reduced from 51.5 MB to 37.5 MB, a reduction of 27%.

Additionally, voice playback is no longer interrupted when opening a menu or hiding the text box, and a rare case where a "list.remove(x): x not in list" exception can occur on startup has been fixed.

notes.title: A Kiss For The Petals - Remembering How We Met updated to version 1.7
notes.content:
This version includes several minor fixes and one critical fix: The unique heart character has been embedded in the font. As it is no longer a small graphic, it now scales cleanly with the text even when the window is resized or set to full screen. Declarations of love now come across sharp and clear even at 1080p resolution and beyond:

Before:
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10023194/babbf2aa1370b8311a06ceb1fb30416d6a220575.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10023194/31bd6c51fa1c9b3dc5adb0e80927c2acd49a4bed.png[/img][/url] 
After:
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10023194/cdd3808c35f166faf8e388d622b616c33fd2cc95.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10023194/9af187322a5ce8d6216f498b91283fe712b90fd5.png[/img][/url]

The tilde has also been similarly revised, as it also used a graphic to replace the font's native tilde character.

In addition, the program is now delivered as separate versions for each platform, rather than a multiplatform build. This is due to macOS Sierra restrictions on running unsigned apps, which was addressed in version 1.6. Please see this forum thread for more information: http://steamcommunity.com/app/397270/discussions/0/343786195676093716/

notes.title: A Kiss For The Petals - Remembering How We Met updated to version 1.3
notes.content:
This version is built in Ren'Py 6.99.9, which features rewritten audio code and bugfixes, including a major fix for Windows when using DPI scaling other than the default setting in fullscreen mode.

Ren'Py 6.99.9's new audio features includes support for the [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Opus_(audio_format)]Opus audio codec[/url], an all-purpose, royalty-free format that boasts superior audio quality and compression efficiency than other leading formats such as MP3, AAC, and Ogg Vorbis. By recompressing the music into this new format, the total file size for this release is 9 MB smaller than previously, with no loss in quality. The new audio code has also allowed us to handle music loops much more efficiently, which may result in a slight performance improvement.

notes.content:
This version has two major changes:

- Ren'Py has been updated to version 6.99.7. This version corrects a reported issue with replays from the Memories menu. If a replay ends with the Skip switch enabled, the Skip state was preserved, which affected the CG viewer and other menu elements. Ren'Py 6.99.7 terminates skipping when a replay ends.

- Achievement data is synchronized on program start. Any achievements earned in the MangaGamer.com version are unlocked on the Steam version during the opening logos when run from the same computer.
